Question: Let \(n\) be the least positive integer greater than \(1000\) for which \[ \begin{gathered} \gcd(63,n+120)=21\\ \text{and}\\ \gcd(n+63,120)=60. \end{gathered} \] What is the sum of the digits of \(n?\)
